Tap the element with that text (or description), the one with that id, or a
point, as listed by `adbuddy screen`. Exactly one of them.

Usage:
  adbuddy tap ["<text>"] [--id <id>] [--xy <x,y>] [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy tap "Network & internet"
  adbuddy tap --id com.android.settings:id/search_action_bar
  adbuddy tap --xy 540,1200

Flags:
  -h, --help        help for tap
      --id string   the element's id, as 'adbuddy screen' lists it
      --xy string   a point on the screen, x,y in pixels

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout
